verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships an official MCP server that gives 'every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer' with natural-language tool selection, confirmed by a docs probe locating the live MCP documentation page, and independently corroborated by an HN report citing 60k+ daily users of Supermemory MCP. Missing for 10: a detailed list of supported MCP clients/setup steps and deeper hands-on third-party review of connection reliability beyond usage stats.
